WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(itemID) AS (
  SELECT i.itemID
  FROM items i
  WHERE i.itemTypeID = 3   -- attachment
  -- 可改成只查一个特定 key
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ia.parentItemID
  FROM itemAttachments ia
  JOIN ancestors a ON ia.itemID = a.itemID
  WHERE ia.parentItemID IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT inote.parentItemID
  FROM itemNotes inote
  JOIN ancestors a ON inote.itemID = a.itemID
)
SELECT i.key AS ParentKey,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName='title' THEN idv.value END) AS title,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName='abstractNote' THEN idv.value END) AS abstract,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName='publicationTitle' THEN idv.value END) AS journal,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName='date' THEN idv.value END) AS date,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(c.lastName || ', ' || c.firstName, '; ')
        FROM itemCreators ic JOIN creators c ON ic.creatorID=c.creatorID
        WHERE ic.itemID=i.itemID
        ORDER BY ic.orderIndex) AS authors,
       (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name,'; ')
        FROM itemTags it JOIN tags t ON it.tagID=t.tagID
        WHERE it.itemID=i.itemID) AS keywords
FROM ancestors a
JOIN items i ON i.itemID=a.itemID
LEFT JOIN itemData id ON id.itemID=i.itemID
LEFT JOIN fields f ON id.fieldID=f.fieldID
LEFT JOIN itemDataValues idv ON id.valueID=idv.valueID
WHERE i.itemTypeID NOT IN (3,40)
GROUP BY i.key;

SELECT 
    /* --- 关键标识符 --- */
    parent.key AS parentKey,           -- 父条目（论文）的 Key：用于元数据关联
    child.key AS attachmentKey,        -- 附件（PDF）的 Key：用于定位 storage 文件夹
    
    /* --- 核心元数据 --- */
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName = 'title'            THEN idv.value END) AS title,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName = 'abstractNote'     THEN idv.value END) AS abstract,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName = 'publicationTitle' THEN idv.value END) AS journal,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName = 'DOI'              THEN idv.value END) AS doi,
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName = 'url'              THEN idv.value END) AS url, -- 新增的网址信息
    MAX(CASE WHEN f.fieldName = 'date'             THEN idv.value END) AS publishDate,

    /* --- 标签聚合 --- */
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t.name, '; ') 
     FROM tags t 
     JOIN itemTags it ON t.tagID = it.tagID 
     WHERE it.itemID = parent.itemID) AS keywords

FROM items AS child
-- 附件关系联表
JOIN itemAttachments AS ia ON child.itemID = ia.itemID 
JOIN items AS parent ON ia.parentItemID = parent.itemID 
-- 元数据值联表
JOIN itemData AS id ON parent.itemID = id.itemID
JOIN fields AS f ON id.fieldID = f.fieldID
JOIN itemDataValues AS idv ON id.valueID = idv.valueID

/* --- 这里的 Key 既可以是附件的，也可以改为 parent.key --- */
WHERE child.key = '3ZUNEJPW' 

GROUP BY parent.itemID, child.key;
